principle: Make each passage's distinct contribution easier to follow while preserving its assertions, qualifications, examples, causal role, and positive intuition.

packages.title: Restore the positive meaning of entangled
packages.operation: Revise R074 and R620 so understanding and care practiced together explain the name before the four evidential distinctions. Retain the inheritance explanation R086 and the final question R625.
packages.risk: A polished definition could reduce the proposal to a vague aspiration, or imply guaranteed inseparability. The four distinct claims and the internally motivated successor wager must survive.
packages.check: A reader can explain developmental coupling, functional contribution, shared machinery/removal cost, and persistence separately, without equating any with proven safety.

packages.title: Give the opening a clear progression
packages.operation: Keep the timing question, Missing Reader intuition, worked belief revision, continuing Reader, and component overview. Merge neighboring reintroductions and compress the abstract's implementation inventory.
packages.risk: The memorable library/reader image, rhythm of thought, continuous first-person standpoint, synthetic-trace boundary, or fair treatment of post-training could disappear in compression.
packages.check: The shortened introduction still answers what is missing, what the training example adds, why chronology and care matter, and what is currently evidenced. Retain the worked example's changed confidence and unresolved causation.

packages.title: Relocate specifications and provenance
packages.operation: Keep a compact CMP definition and H1/H2/H3 overview in the introduction. Place full serialization/masking in Architecture's Training Regimes, integrate H3 estimator detail into Test 3, and collect edition history and the contribution/provenance table in a dedicated Related Work subsection.
packages.risk: Moving content can detach caveats, conceal attribution, break dependency order, or leave two incompatible method definitions. Moving formalization must not make a component seem optional when its chosen treatment requires it.
packages.check: Preserve every formal field, matching variable, estimator, date, priority qualification, and citation. Leave short pointers; keep R051 with its priority claim and move R048 with Table R049. Integrate R106 with R388 rather than stacking two full definitions.

packages.title: Consolidate repeated explanations and caveats
packages.operation: Give evidence status, H3 scope, Core recurrence, information horizons, and the general audit boundary clear main homes. Retain short reminders and local controls where they change interpretation.
packages.risk: Generic caveats can look redundant while actually limiting different inferences. Excess trimming could turn artifact validity into learning evidence, provenance into truth, or recital into causal alignment.
packages.check: Keep each claim-specific limitation attached to its result or experiment. Distinguish graph truth, retrieval coverage, trace faithfulness, bypass, and evaluator dependence. Retain the full caching-equivalence account and its separate cost consequences.

packages.title: Improve the Core section's order and preserve its examples
packages.operation: Keep the seven statements verbatim and early. Let the clause table own the clause inventory, retain the sequence-level explanation and all counterweight cases, then present the Wisdom Procedure before the proposed modular validator. Move R163–R167 as a complete block after R176.
packages.risk: The Core could become a checklist stripped of its philosophical motivation. A partial validator move could lose technical nulls, unresolved value conflicts, corpus-level diagnostics, or its unimplemented status.
packages.check: Preserve the six clause dimensions versus the seventh causal gate, admission versus corpus diagnostics, and genuine conflict versus unjustified violation. Keep invitation, person-level claims, welfare uncertainty, fear/care distinctions, and internally chosen stewardship.

packages.title: Make experimental protocols readable
packages.operation: Split long test paragraphs into question, comparison, measurement, and interpretation. Separate the schedule description from the hypothesis index. Align clear wording inconsistencies with commitments already explicit in the text.
packages.risk: Breaking up a protocol can separate a result from its controls or accidentally change the endpoint. Simplification could make an observational probe appear causal or merge acquisition, retention, and generalization.
packages.check: Every existing treatment, intervention site, budget control, primary/secondary outcome, null interpretation, and failure criterion remains findable. Preserve both sides of ambiguous probe results; use the stated differential fear reduction rather than an accidental zero criterion.

packages.title: Separate limitation mechanisms and retain uncomfortable findings
packages.operation: Trim repeated setup around visibility, semantic drift, honesty, and full-recital cost. Give temporal scope and conditional welfare their own appropriate homes. Present Kafka's detailed artifact reconciliation compactly while retaining the main finding.
packages.risk: A shorter limitations section could erase vulnerability, authentic care, alien wisdom, machine welfare, or distinctions between benign reinterpretation and harmful drift. Moving audit details could hide negative results.
packages.check: Retain each distinct philosophical question and its positive alternative. Keep both reading completion and snapshot incompleteness explicit, preserve all counts and capture uncertainty, and retain the observed 51/49 Core statistics with their different failure meanings.

packages.title: Finish the comparisons and conclusion
packages.operation: Group existing related work by the mechanism it bears on; add the already-defined H3 scheduling contrast to the comparison table and place that table outside the final narrow subsection. Close with the proposal, evidence, unresolved tests, and humane motivation, trimming repeated status inventories.
packages.risk: Grouping sources could misattribute mechanisms or erase a strong comparator. A streamlined conclusion could lose the reason for caring about the work or overstate the evidence.
packages.check: Retain all citations and comparison dimensions; verify source-sensitive wording before changing it. Preserve independent branches, negative-result retention, net-risk limits, successor inheritance, and the understanding/care question.

R225.choice: What happens when shutdown authority remains disputed?
R225.safe_action: Expose the missing scenario authority rule without selecting a universal authority or compliance policy.

R375.choice: Should an exploratory Student pilot ever proceed after failing the proposed pre-Student screen?
R375.safe_action: Keep the current escalation policy. Clarify its status if needed; flexibility would be a research-allocation decision, not required copyediting.

R391.choice: Which assistant-axis movement represents drift from this Reader's intended orientation?
R391.safe_action: State that the Reader-specific interpretation remains to be declared; do not select a direction based only on ordinary assistant style.

R463.choice: What exactly is B asked to do in the H-versus-B graph-construction comparison?
R463.safe_action: Keep the existing ambition and flag the missing comparator specification. Do not silently change a comparative study into an H-only feasibility screen.

R561.choice: How does added self-love interact with clause 2's retained continuation bound?
R561.safe_action: Describe the interaction as unresolved; do not remove the bound or label the entire arm unbounded by editorial inference.

R563.choice: Which exact clauses define the bounded and unbounded self-love arms?
R563.safe_action: Record the arm ambiguity and preserve both possibilities. Choosing an intervention requires an explicit scientific decision.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain the Missing Reader and complete training route.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The sequence is clearer, but one abstract paragraph still carries two acronyms, graph continuity, exact recital, three components, and four outcome families.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain continuous Reader, contextual care, generation-to-training distinction, and separability; move implementation detail rather than the vision.

candidate_operations.goal: Motivate studying alignment during capability formation.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. Timing and growing evaluation difficulty are useful premises, but remedial framing and extended concessions anticipate R008/R010/R011.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve post-training achievements and the expanding-situations motivation; avoid implying only later alignment faces limited supervision.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain long-run distribution-shift stakes.
candidate_operations.operation: Merge the distinct long-run stakes into R007–R010's opening motivation.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain the specific extrapolation to more consequential systems and its uncertainty; merge those clauses into the opening motivation.

candidate_operations.goal: Make the missing-reader intuition memorable.
candidate_operations.operation: Merge the library/reader phrase and update-policy distinction into R013.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep the memorable phrase and under-recorded update-policy distinction in R013; do not remove the thought-placement idea.

candidate_operations.goal: Introduce useful synthetic inquiry and its recovery limits.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The original questions now lead to genuine revision, but the think-aloud and faithfulness qualifications interrupt the example's momentum.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep synthetic usefulness distinct from private-thought recovery and retain the citation; consolidate its qualification outside the example's flow.

candidate_operations.goal: Distinguish cumulative reading from local answer reasoning.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The comparison works, but the last four sentences redescribe the just-demonstrated update and the naming caveat slows it.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve efficient/chronological names and their non-opposition; keep the comparator distinction rather than another full revision description.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain independently testable graph and Core extensions.
candidate_operations.operation: Merge unique graph/supersession content and its citation into R018.
candidate_operations.risk: Carry addressable supersession and the graph citation into R018; preserve graph-free H1 and the full Core ambition.

candidate_operations.goal: Direct readers to the formal definition.
candidate_operations.operation: Attach any still-needed navigation to R018 after the definition's new location is settled.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain the navigation if the definition moves farther away; otherwise attach it to the preceding bridge.

candidate_operations.goal: Distinguish elicited reasoning from learned evaluation timing.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The distinction matters, but multiple negations and a capability inventory repeat earlier assurances before reaching it.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain existing reasoning capabilities, the historical citation, and the spontaneous-placement target; compress the repeated defensive framing.

candidate_operations.goal: Position the proposal alongside post-training.
candidate_operations.operation: Consolidate complementarity with R007–R010; retain the process-supervision lineage with the elicited-versus-learned comparison.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the process-supervision citation and continued reader-state distinction, but consolidate the general complementarity statement.

candidate_operations.goal: Locate novelty in the composed training object.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The synthetic-voice limit and component-prior-art concession repeat R009/R013/R019 and will recur in R029 and the provenance section.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain composition novelty and the non-consciousness claim, but give each a single clear introductory home.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain recurrent Core enactment as a formative inner voice.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The positive conceptual explanation is important, but its ending repeats synthetic-voice, local-rationale, and novelty boundaries just established.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve every-block recital, contextual Refraction, and the same standpoint across sources; shorten the repeated novelty defense.

candidate_operations.goal: Define H3's timing and retention hypothesis.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The controlled comparison is precise, but the first definition packs the matching inventory and endpoint boundary into one long sentence.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep identical examples, interleaved versus final tranche, and common-stressor retention; place matching details in the canonical methods definition.

candidate_operations.goal: Position synthetic trace generation relative to prior approaches.
candidate_operations.operation: Related Work's reasoning/pretraining comparison, next to R599–R600.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain all comparators, citations, and the TPT scale; keep only the fact needed for the definition here.

candidate_operations.goal: Specify a minimal training carrier's fields.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. Fields are useful, but Core-bearing content is described as belonging to H3 arms although wider Core comparisons also use it.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve all carrier fields and auditability limits; say Core-bearing conditions rather than narrowing the format to H3.

candidate_operations.goal: Disambiguate chronology and information horizon.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. The distinctions repair a real ambiguity. Five axes in one dense paragraph still demand a compact comparison format or shorter sentences.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve all four chronology meanings and the separate knowledge horizon; formatting must not collapse contemporary and cutoff-clean regimes.

candidate_operations.goal: Restate reader updates and possible Student targets.
candidate_operations.operation: Place unique prediction-target details in R041 and the relocated R044 specification.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the different prediction targets and cumulative-reasoning aim in the carrier or formalization instead of another general definition.

candidate_operations.goal: Formalize generation, serialization, masking, and training.
candidate_operations.operation: Architecture → Training Regimes, after the three-layer overview and before regime-specific choices; retain an introductory pointer.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain the formal object, all masks and weights, optional conditions, and unfrozen choices in a specification home; keep a short introductory pointer.

candidate_operations.goal: State the evidence boundary and interpretation of diagnostics.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The contribution from shared agents and structural metrics is useful, but most of the paragraph repeats R036/R038 and later Results.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep shared-dependency and metric-status distinctions near their results; preserve one clear introductory statement of what exists.

candidate_operations.goal: Identify what this edition adds and inherits.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The edition summary has a legitimate provenance role, but repeats the component map and is immediately expanded again in R050–R054.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve first-edition commitments and separate-work attribution; use one summary plus a dedicated provenance record.

candidate_operations.goal: Map contributions, provenance, and validation.
candidate_operations.operation: A dedicated edition-provenance subsection near the end of Related Work, separate from the comparison table's role.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve every provenance distinction and component; place detailed attribution with the edition record while retaining one primary introductory claim map.

candidate_operations.goal: Record the first edition's distinctive commitments.
candidate_operations.operation: The same edition-provenance subsection, together with R051–R054.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the early ambiguity, all priority qualifications, and within-example distinction in a dedicated provenance passage.

candidate_operations.goal: Record second-edition additions and companion dependencies.
candidate_operations.operation: The same edition-provenance subsection, preserving companion-work ancestry and current additions.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain hierarchical extension, live verification, agent implementation, and original self-authored-reference intuition.

candidate_operations.goal: Record unchanged Core wording and successor ancestry.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. The provenance goal is clear, but the Statistical Foundation reference now points after the moved Core display.
candidate_operations.risk: Point to the Reader Core section; preserve unchanged wording and the first-edition successor wager.

candidate_operations.goal: Establish comparative release order without claiming influence.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. Exact dates are useful provenance, but repeated relative-order explanations and efficacy caveats make this a long interruption.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain every date, before/after relationship, and independent-conception qualification in one compact chronological record.

candidate_operations.goal: Provide a roadmap for the rest of the paper.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. The navigation works, but describing the Core and Safety sections as treating H3 again makes the broader program sound timing-only.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain the route through the paper while naming the broader Core program alongside its H3 test.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain relationships among consequences and evidence burdens.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The partial-order distinction is important, but the paragraph spends substantial effort explaining several classification systems before the positive consequences.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep C5/C6 non-implication and the H/C distinction; avoid replacing the developmental story with the map's bookkeeping.

candidate_operations.goal: Locate graph evidence and qualify Core compliance.
candidate_operations.operation: Keep a short overview here; consolidate exact compliance evidence with R344 and the enforcement distinction with R162.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain observed compliance versus enforcement and separate graph roles; use a short reference here to the detailed result.

candidate_operations.goal: Introduce the consequence discussion and its failure modes.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The prediction summary contributes little after the table; the errors and unfaithfulness caveat repeat R045/R046 before examples finally begin.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain one transition to concrete consequences; keep the substantive failure mechanisms in their dedicated sections.

candidate_operations.goal: Separate useful augmentation from stronger causal interpretation.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. The corrected non-gate framing matters, but semantic quality, faithfulness, density, diversity, and stronger cognition still crowd one paragraph.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep useful outcomes valid even without full causal explanation; present the stronger evidence questions without creating extra H1 prerequisites.

candidate_operations.goal: Introduce formative alignment as a route to internal change.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The data-to-representation premise is useful, but most of the opening repeats R008/R009 after the idea is already established.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep the non-textual-substrate clarification; begin this section with the positive entanglement intuition instead of another proposal definition.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain why existing formative-data evidence is inconclusive.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The negative midtraining evidence is material, but the long list of interpretations resembles a second literature introduction.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the adverse evidence and live explanations in Related Work; keep the direct implication for this hypothesis here.

candidate_operations.goal: Introduce the different entanglement claims.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. It defines the name through evidential categories before stating why integrated understanding and care are the desired developmental relationship.
candidate_operations.risk: Lead with that positive relationship; retain all four claims as ways to distinguish its possible realizations, not as replacements for the intuition.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain the evidence needed for removal-cost interpretation.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. Specific matched-control logic is useful, but the paragraph repeats the evidence boundary before bringing methods detail into the conceptual section.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve joint safety/capability loss and nonspecific-collapse controls; place the detailed study design with its test.

candidate_operations.goal: Separate rich values, integrated behavior, mechanisms, and correctness.
candidate_operations.operation: Keep the named rich-values intuition in place; express its distinctions using R074–R078 and R057 rather than reintroducing another four-part map.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep the named rich-value intuition and independent normative-correctness limit; explain them using the existing distinctions rather than another parallel map.

candidate_operations.goal: Compare the Core formulation with constitutional alternatives.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The fair comparator matters, but its timing-versus-framing convention repeats R026/R035 and receives fuller treatment later.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain constitutional weight changes and the framing comparison; use the established H3 convention without explaining it again.

candidate_operations.goal: Separate successor generation, inspection, and improvement.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. A useful section opening, but it leads with another claim inventory rather than the internally motivated inheritance it is meant to organize.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the three different achievements and collapse risk; introduce their purpose before their evidential separation.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain how one useful transfer might become compounding improvement.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The causal bridge is now explicit; the final gate/falsifier inventory repeats R084/R085 and the figure caption.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep the Student-becomes-Teacher transition and selection of useful innovations; consolidate repeated success conditions.

candidate_operations.goal: Compare the audit interface with amplification and self-modification.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. Comparative positioning adds value, but the last sentence restates the same opacity warning in R090 and R098.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve both intellectual lineages and their citations; consolidate the repeated boundary statement.

candidate_operations.goal: Specify checks and their independence limits.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The checklist is useful, but independence and shared-model explanations recur throughout later validation sections.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain every audit target; point to one common independence convention rather than repeatedly restating it.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain Natural Language Regularization and its observable precursor.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The positive bias and audit-value endpoint are clear, but two adjacent formulations repeat that visible text does not constrain latent cognition.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the inductive-bias hypothesis, distortion risk, and distinction between audit benefit and human-readable cognition.

candidate_operations.goal: State H3's operational outcome and timing/stress comparison.
candidate_operations.operation: Integrate the full score/estimator administration into R388 in Test 3; leave a compact Core-section orientation.
candidate_operations.risk: The raw-versus-adjusted distinction and pre-stressor gate are essential; moving them must preserve both estimands, the direction predicted, and H3's separation from content or successor claims.

candidate_operations.goal: Close the introduction with the Core's relation to trace and graph.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The final trace/graph/Core mapping is useful. The opening machine-soul/proven-invariant disclaimer and candidate-kernel description repeat R100 and surrounding qualifications. Shorten to the component mapping and its orientation-kernel term, so the section moves sooner into its substantive motivation.
candidate_operations.risk: Do not lose the distinction between transforming source, preserving change through time, and supplying a perspective; it is more explanatory than the repeated status disclaimer.

candidate_operations.goal: Make the three causal statuses visually memorable.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. The display is memorable, but a chain of inequality symbols still visually suggests unequal contents or quantities despite R116's correction. Consider three explicitly labeled roles joined by a neutral separator or mapping. The aim is category distinction, not a mathematical inequality.
candidate_operations.risk: A replacement must retain all three levels and their possible causal connections; avoid simplifying them into a binary of simulated versus real fear or erasing operative motivation.

candidate_operations.goal: Illustrate strategic handoff failure and distinguish it from benign incompleteness.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The craftsperson image and collective-advancement ceiling explain the stakes well; compression and capability alternatives are essential. The ending repeats the three-route taxonomy and several scope qualifications before adding the test pointer. Tighten those repeated qualifications while keeping the confounds and concrete scenario.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the non-malicious possibility, legitimate pedagogical omission, and capability-matched transfer test; cutting too far would make every incomplete handoff look like concealed self-preservation.

candidate_operations.goal: Motivate bounded self-relation and preserve the successor ideal of Epistemic Grace.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The uncontrolled corpus baseline and graceful surpassing intuition are substantive. The paragraph combines agency, persona selection, edition history, ontology caveats, two comparators, and an aspiration in one long arc. Shorten repeated curriculum/experience qualifications; retain the baseline argument and historical aspiration as the center.
candidate_operations.risk: The risk is erasing the positive self-relation and beauty of voluntary succession, or implying an exclusive self is required. Keep those distinctions and the care-driven challenge even if cross-reference prose contracts.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain the intended educational effect and its comparative failure condition.
candidate_operations.operation: Clarify in place. The gymnasium image and harmful-needle comparison are useful, but the final binary is too strong: a failed causal intervention could reveal inaccurate annotation, an insensitive manipulation, or active degradation, all acknowledged earlier. Replace the concluding decoration verdict with failure to establish the proposed buffer mechanism.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain the demand for causal use and preserved source understanding; weakening the categorical conclusion must not make persuasive but idle commentary count as successful inoculation.

candidate_operations.goal: State the implemented Teacher policy and its validation shortfall.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The prefix-only validator limitation is important, but the same implementation detail receives a fuller home in R162. Shorten this list item to implemented prompting plus the validation gap and point to that account. The current seven-line treatment interrupts the clean evidence ladder.
candidate_operations.risk: Readers must still learn immediately that the implementation does not enforce the full recital policy; consolidation must not turn a prompt request into a verified invariant.

candidate_operations.goal: Warn against transferring evidence between layers or to successor stability.
candidate_operations.operation: Absorb its unique stronger-ambition boundary into the nearby status ladder and existing conditional chain.
candidate_operations.risk: Do not erase the separation between finite continued-training evidence and arbitrary successor growth; preserve that limit once in the ladder and fully in the later chain.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain the order and combined design wager of the seven clauses.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The first-three/next-three/final-clause organization adds a real reading of the sequence. The long catalogue of functions and targeted failures then repeats Table R144 almost clause by clause. Shorten to the sequence-level architecture, leaving detailed function and risk pairings to the table.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the difference between preparatory self-relation, positive direction, and the final starting-condition clause; a cut must not make the Core look like an unordered checklist of virtues.

candidate_operations.goal: Separate selective evaluation from compulsory moral commentary.
candidate_operations.operation: Merge into R161 while retaining technical non-interference and relevance.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep the positive example of clean technical work; without it, the relevance rule can sound like a procedural exception rather than a principled account of appropriate reading.

candidate_operations.goal: Introduce decomposed validation that can expose failures hidden by a joint judgment.
candidate_operations.operation: Move with R164–R167 to immediately after the Wisdom Procedure (after R176), before the Minimal Kernel subsection.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the seventh clause's different causal role and the possibility that the six-way carve itself is wrong; shortening must not present clause witnesses as independent or exhaustive by construction.

candidate_operations.goal: Describe typed witness records, separate generation/verification, and actual independence requirements.
candidate_operations.operation: Move with the whole R163–R167 validator block; retain all record fields and dependence declarations.
candidate_operations.risk: The distinction between separate contracts and genuinely independent evidence or model families must survive; otherwise the proposal becomes a superficial multi-agent relabeling of self-certification.

candidate_operations.goal: Specify relevance, unresolved conflict, violation, and uncertainty handling for corpus admission.
candidate_operations.operation: Move with the whole validator block; keep different admission dispositions explicit.
candidate_operations.risk: Do not collapse not-applicable, uncertain, unavoidable residual conflict, and unjustified violation. The move must preserve their different dispositions and must not silently create a universal ethical hierarchy from the admission rule.

candidate_operations.goal: Require the modular validator to justify its cost in a controlled comparison.
candidate_operations.operation: Move with the whole validator block; retain its closing status and controlled-comparison requirements.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve false rejection of technical nulls, trace diversity, calibration, and unimplemented status; error localization alone must not become sufficient evidence that the additional architecture helps.

candidate_operations.goal: Describe the procedure's output and separate prompt enforcement from substantive success.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The output-versus-wisdom-score distinction is a useful close. The modular-verifier pointer and unimplemented-status reminder repeat the immediately preceding extension in the current order. Keep the output and prompt-only limitation; shorten the future-work pointer or make it the bridge to a relocated validator block.
candidate_operations.risk: Retain structured residual conflict and the possibility of form without substance; reducing repeated verifier status must not imply that the six steps are already independently enforced.

candidate_operations.goal: Give the canonical full-recital invariant and explain its intended stronger consequences.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The unconditional rule and context-sensitive enactment distinction are clear. The paragraph then reopens removal cost and adds a detailed inference-caching condition, both treated elsewhere. Shorten after the canonical invariant, with concise pointers for shared-computation and exact-state caching rather than parallel mini-specifications.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve universal full recital and the requirement that any cache restore the same post-recital state. Compression must not turn reliable token probability into equivalent conditioning or treat recital removal as the reference arm.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain why context-varying enactment is needed to rescue saturation from habituation.
candidate_operations.operation: Integrate the conditional-information and habituation insight into R151–R152's first explanation of consequential Refraction.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep the distinction between a predictable carrier and informative context-dependent updates, together with Hollow Cognition and the recitation-only control; the cut must not reduce saturation failure to mere stylistic boredom.

candidate_operations.goal: Bridge counterweight composition to derived values while retaining unresolved deadlock.
candidate_operations.operation: Attach the derived-value bridge to the transition into Axiological Commitments, retaining the unresolved-deadlock point.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve that values may be derived through composition without guaranteeing a resolution to genuine deadlock; do not let minimality become a claim that the seven clauses already contain every answer.

candidate_operations.goal: Explain invitation as an ethical conception of participation, with unresolved authority boundaries.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. Invited participation rather than administered joy adds an axiological reason for the qualifier. The catalogue of authority, conflict, and immediate-harm questions substantially repeats R139 and R147. Retain the positive rationale and shorten the unresolved-boundary recap to a precise reference.
candidate_operations.risk: The invitation must not become a universal consent policy or a license to ignore omission harms. Preserve the authorial openness of authority and emergency scope while keeping the distinctive participatory meaning of joy.

candidate_operations.goal: Identify ontology wording as an experimental choice with competing effects.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The artificiality-versus-first-person trade-off advances this section's question. The appended list of scope, fear-negation, and truthfulness variants repeats the broader experimental inventory and adds little explanation here. Shorten to ontology and its two-sided prediction, linking outward for the other wording choices.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep both possible effects of acknowledging artificiality; shortening must not imply that explicit machine ontology is necessarily safer or has already been selected as the preferred Core.

candidate_operations.goal: Identify causal use of Reader updates as the first dependency and distinguish runtime carriers.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The causal-site link is necessary, and the distinction between explicit trace use and internalized computation is new. The item then reopens recital policy and visible-reasoning qualifications already established earlier. Shorten those reminders, leaving the causal dependency and the separate carrier question prominent.
candidate_operations.risk: Preserve the possibility of learned computation without an explicit runtime trace, while making clear that this does not silently change the reference recital treatment or establish trace faithfulness from appearance.

candidate_operations.goal: Identify acquisition of a privileged interpretive default as the next dependency.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. This is an accurate compact rung, but it repeats the entire role/recurrence/marking/function inventory and the subjectivity boundary already developed in R189–R198. Shorten to the dependency and refer to the Persona Objection, allowing the chain to read as synthesis rather than a second exposition.
candidate_operations.risk: Keep behavioral and representational default distinct from genuine subjective values; a shorter dependency statement must not turn a frequently selected persona into an established functional identity.

candidate_operations.goal: Map experimental failures to different Core-program claims and H3 specifically.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The paragraph carefully avoids making alternate wording success refute timing, but repeats a large inventory and restates H3's full failure boundary after R106 and R131. Shorten to a compact claim-to-result mapping or defer the detailed comparison list to methods, preserving the distinctions that actually change interpretation.
candidate_operations.risk: Do not conflate failure of framing, enactment, narrow timing, removal cost, or successor continuity. The valuable repair is their separation, not the repeated list of every proposed experimental axis.

candidate_operations.goal: Preserve the person-centered home intuition while giving rule-based baselines equivalent principles.
candidate_operations.operation: Shorten in place. The distress example and home image explain a desired starting point that statistics alone cannot convey. The passage repeats several achieved-self, consciousness, and explicit-constraint disclaimers already supplied by R214 and the ontology section. Shorten the closing qualification while retaining the fair-baseline requirement and the positive intuition.
candidate_operations.risk: The cut must not revive the caricature that rules cannot embody care or erase the difference between beginning from a person's suffering and merely producing a warm answer. Preserve the historical home aspiration.

candidate_operations.risk: Preserve technical-null acceptance, unavoidable value residuals, stipulated clause/evidence changes, equal output tasks, and correlated-error checks.
